Read for this record: card #35232 (body and all seven comments, dev report 7181804946 included), its epic #35205 (body and comments; ruling record 6988162359 carries the 16:19Z 「同意」 to the fleet skills review and its order; 6997472894 carries 「可以拆的都同意。」), PR #37420 body and file list (17 files, all under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/`), the net diff `origin/main...ef857400` hunk by hunk, the 48 check-runs on the head (no failure; where a name appears twice the newer run is success or an expected skip), PR #35587 (step 4b) for context. Code outside the diff was read, not reviewed: `scripts/pm/card-pick.mjs`, `check-half-states.mjs` (`seatIntakeKeys`, `claimSeatNumber`), `record-recognisers.mjs` (`readContractReviewHandoff`), `dispatch-gates.mjs` (the `--tier` clause-② note), `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`. The three review reports under `pm-orders/objectstack/skills-review-2026-11-18/` are not on the mount I can read, so the ruling's words available to me are the card's scope paragraph and the two quoted answers; every judgment below is made against those.

### ① Derived judgments

- No accept set and no public surface moves: the diff is skill text only, no script, schema, workflow, agent definition or ADR. Right.
- The rule surface does move. Three rule-meaning changes are the ruled direction itself and match the card's scope sentence word for word in meaning: a lane is a seat or an epic subtree (SKILL.md 〈车道与域〉 line 1); cards are picked by area/epic under the grade rules and a lease only guards same-file concurrency (line 2, area-lease.md:7, lanes/objectstack.md:27); the five domain seats are retired and `domain:*` stays as file ownership (line 4). Right.
- `Rule-change: yes` on the PR body is right, and `ruled` would be wrong: the wording is the PR's own, not a copy of quoted ruling text, and the body carries no `Ruling-ref:` line to copy from. The pull request waits for the maintainer.
- The four deletions the dev lists, each judged against the ruling's words (lanes become seats plus epics; the domain seats retire; a lease only guards file overlap):
  1. Seat relabel (席改标): AUTHORISED. Its trigger was "the remainder's paths fall wholly in this seat's package tree", which only a domain seat has. A reader is not left without a path: a wrong `domain:*` goes to triage through `pm:retriage` (the row keeps 改判; cross-repo-coordination.md keeps 误标挂 `pm:retriage`+异议). The new red-line wording 「执行席 ⛔ 不改 `domain:*`」 is stricter than a bare deletion, and it agrees with text already on main: lanes/objectstack.md 「⛔ 不产、不改 `domain:*`」, triage-duties.md self-triage 「⛔ 不改 `domain:*`」, and SKILL.md 「`domain:*` 与队列只由分诊落笔」 (its two exceptions write a label at creation, they do not change one).
  2. Cross-domain exception path, five channels to four: AUTHORISED. The path existed so that triage could name one domain lane for an unsplittable cross-domain PR; a whole-repository seat crosses domains by definition (the `repo:objectstack` row). What the second deleted line protected, the in-flight intersection, survives unscoped in the line kept above it (派发前在飞检查) and in `overlap-check.mjs`. Removing a channel narrows what a seat may do out of lane, the safe direction. No other file and no script names the path or the count.
  3. "A clause-② hit is the spec lane's work": the deletion is AUTHORISED (it routes work to a retired seat), and the tier and review halves of the clause-② rule are untouched. But the routing has a second home the PR did not account for — see S2.
  4. The domain half of the `Part of` remainder state: AUTHORISED. It told the landing seat to set or change `domain:*`, which the red line now forbids; the remainder still lands in one state and the kept line 「同笔评论写清交付了什么、剩下归谁」 still names who takes it.
- One further removal is not in the body's list and is also authorised: the "notify the other lane's online seat" half of the stay-in-lane line (area-lease.md:47, lanes/objectstack.md:19). There is no domain seat left to notify.

### ② Semver level

- No published package changes; `skip-changeset` is right and the changeset check is green/skipped as expected.
- `Clause-②: no` is right: no published accept set or export surface is touched. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev deviation "four deletions rather than rewrites": answered in ① — all four authorised; (3) leaves S2.
- Dev claim (c), "behaviour is unchanged where the Seat grammar, the card-pick rows and footer and the hand-off target still read `domain:*`": TRUE as far as it goes, read on main. `card-pick.mjs` prints `domainOf` on every row and the lane-ownership line of `UNREAD_LEGS`; `parseSeat`, the mailbox `seatKey` and `CLAIM_SEAT_DECLARATION_ANYWHERE` accept `domain:X#N` beside `repo:` and `epic:`; `HANDOFF_TARGET` accepts only an L2 seat or `domain:lane#N`. The new claim-template line (`repo:NAME#n` or `epic:#N#k`) is exactly what `claimSeatNumber` reads. The new execution-duties.md line tells a seat how to read the card-pick footer, so text and tool do not contradict there. The claim is INCOMPLETE in two places: the `--tier` note (S2) and where the tools read a seat's intake (S1).
- Dev deviation and open question (d), ratchet rows not lowered: lowering is NOT owed. `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` says a ceiling "may be LOWERED by any PR that shrinks its file — lowering is always legitimate and encouraged", the gate is green on the head, and the only prompt is informational above 4096 bytes of headroom. Answer to the open question: B — the rows move in a PR that is allowed to edit `scripts/pm/` (a comment on the open step card that owns that surface carries it); it is not a condition of this PR. Option C costs little: 299 bytes over 15 files.
- Out-of-scope item (e-i), `readContractReviewHandoff` cannot read a `repo:` or `epic:` target: REAL defect, behaviour-affecting, and older than this PR. contract-review.md sends a lane that cannot reach the tier to "a sibling seat that can" when no L2 seat is seated; every live sibling is a `repo:` or `epic:` seat, and a hand-off line naming one reads `unreadable`, so that arm hands the head to nobody. This PR does not cause it and cannot fix it (script surface, and contract-review.md:23 is pinned verbatim by the self-test). It needs a card carrier before ACCEPT: the report's `carrier: PR 37420 acceptance notes` is not a carrier under os-dev.md (a carrier is a card number or a person). A comment on the open same-surface step card, or a tooling card with `reach:` the named producer, satisfies the filing gate.
- Out-of-scope item (e-ii), stale `card-pick.mjs` footer and the ratchet comment naming 〈域车道〉: real but wording only; the new execution-duties.md line already tells the seat how to read the footer. No card of its own; one line in the same comment on the step card that owns `card-pick.mjs` is enough. Not a condition of ACCEPT.
- Out-of-scope item (e-iii), intake line in the description versus `seatIntakeKeys` reading the title: real, and NOT out of scope — this PR makes that line the definition of a lane. Graded as S1.
- Out-of-scope item four (domain-era leftovers in execution-duties.md: the `ui/**` remainder lines, 他席树, the odd/even alternation): readable and harmless; lanes/objectstack.md:27 already overrides the alternation for the one multi-seat lane. Left to step 4c. Agreed.
- contract-review.md:23 left as is: agreed, for the pin reason the dev gives. It means the card's "no retired domain seat is named as live" holds for the 17 files in the diff and not for that line; (e-i)'s carrier covers it.
- SQL push-down: no query, no id materialisation, no join in the diff.
- Escalated: nothing beyond `Rule-change: yes` itself, which is the maintainer's.

### ④ Design judgment

Per file, against the ruling's words and the code on main.

- `SKILL.md`: the three definition lines hold against the card's scope sentence. The entry-table row (`objectstack` as the seat word) agrees with project-forms.md (seat word = a `lanes/` file name). The `pm:retriage` row, the red line and the channel list agree with each other after the deletions. The `domain:skills` PR line (接卡席 reads it) holds. The claim-template `Seat:` line agrees with `claimSeatNumber`. Findings S1 and S2 touch this file.
- `references/area-lease.md`: line 7 says what the ruling says, and no later line of the file still reads as a card-picking rule (line 45 picks by named scope and grade). `Pre-claim lane:` now records the paths' `domain:*` as file ownership; no script reads that key; its fail condition is the closed hand-over set of line 47. Holds.
- `references/execution-duties.md`: the candidate read by named `area:*` and epic subtree is what `card-pick.mjs --order` and `cardIntakeKeys` do. The new card-pick line is accurate against the script. The `DUTIES_PHRASES` pins are untouched (the self-test check-run is green). S2 touches the clause-② line.
- `references/landing-operations.md`, `coordinator.md`, `cross-repo-coordination.md`, `project-forms.md`, `seat-lifecycle.md`, `lanes/triage.md`, `lanes/objectstack.md`: each rewrite follows from the retirement and contradicts nothing I read on main. `pm-dispatch cloud qa` names two existing lane files.
- `lanes/server.md`, `spec.md`, `ui.md`, `devx.md`, `skills.md`: title and opening line only; the notice (domain reference, 本席 reads as the seat that took the card, pending reorganisation) is the right holding shape for step 4c, and read that way lanes/spec.md's sub-card rule still works.
- `references/seat-post-protocol.md`, `lanes/director.md`: see S3 and the first nit.

Findings:

S1 (should-fix) — the new definition anchors a seat's lane on something the protocol does not define and the tools do not read. SKILL.md:161 and :177, area-lease.md:7, execution-duties.md:7 and lanes/objectstack.md:27 all say the lane is the `area:*` and epic on the seat post's intake line (接卡行). seat-post-protocol.md:18, a file in this diff, defines that line as a line of the description section naming `area:*` only — no epic. And the code that implements "which cards a seat takes" since step 4b, `seatIntakeKeys` (`check-half-states.mjs`, read by H32, H38, H71, H73 and `check-owed-reviews.mjs`), reads `area:x` and `epic #N` off the post TITLE. A seat that follows the text alone writes its intake where no tool looks, and has nowhere to write an epic. Fix inside this PR's files: make the new sentences location-neutral ("the areas and epics the seat post names", which is what the PR body's own English says) or say the title carries them, and let seat-post-protocol.md:18 name the epic. Changing the script is not asked.

S2 (should-fix) — the clause-② routing was deleted from the text while the tool still prints it. `dispatch-gates.mjs --tier` prints on every run "a hit outside the spec lane is spec-lane work and moves there" (and, on a suspect surface, "reviewed … in the spec lane"); `dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs` pins that both lines say the work MOVES there. The claim's `model:` field cites that output, so every seat reads it. After this PR the only text that answers it is the precedence clause of area-lease.md:47, which binds zone seats; an epic seat or a card thread reading execution-duties.md finds the tool pointing at a retired lane and the text silent. SKILL.md:164's blanket sentence covers `domain:*` prints only, and the PR body's measured list of what scripts still say omits this one. Fix: one clause on the clause-② line of execution-duties.md saying the `--tier` spec-lane sentence no longer moves a card (the file has 106 bytes of headroom), and the script wording joins the (e-i)/(e-ii) carrier.

S3 (should-fix) — seat-post-protocol.md:71, 「epic PM 不兼域座位」 became 「epic PM 不兼他席」. On main the clause barred an epic PM from also sitting a domain seat. The retirement removes that subject; it does not say an epic PM may hold no other seat. The new wording newly bars an epic PM from a `repo:` seat, which no quoted ruling says, which sits oddly beside the new SKILL.md:161 (a whole-repository seat's lane includes epics), and which the PR body presents as a spelling change, so the maintainer's approval of `Rule-change: yes` would not knowingly cover it. Fix: delete the clause (its only subject retired, as with the four listed deletions), or keep it and list it in the body's rule changes for the maintainer to rule.

Nits (no effect on correctness; fix on the prose faces or leave):
- lanes/director.md:21 still says the director 「不占 `domain:*` 车道」; coordinator.md's sibling sentence was reworded to 执行席 and this one was not.
- PR body, Acceptance notes: "15 files now carry headroom (the deltas above; SKILL.md 11 bytes)" is not what the ratchet map says. SKILL.md's ceiling is 33919 against 33340 bytes (579, of which 568 were already there on main) and area-lease.md's is 6586 against 6578 (8). The other thirteen match their delta.
- seat-lifecycle.md:49: handover findings are now 「以 `finding` 立卡」 with no lane word; first touch is triage's on the same line, so nothing is lost.

Verdict reasoning: the ruled direction is carried out faithfully, all four listed deletions are authorised, no gate is red, and nothing here is a must-fix. Three should-fixes are open on this head and earn a delta review; the record does not clear the queue guard until they close. The rule change itself waits for the maintainer.
